name: Holman Wholesale Parts & Delivery
old_description: At Holman Wholesale Parts and Delivery, we are fully committed to providing the parts you need, when you need them. We are fortunate to have genuine parts and accessories from dozens of car manufacturers. From luxury, high-performance and sport utility to hybrids, commercial and more.
about:
Based in Raleigh, North Carolina, Holman Wholesale Parts & Delivery operates as the wholesale division of the Holman Automotive Group, a multi-generational automotive retailer in the Southeast. The wholesale arm extends the group's dealership infrastructure to the aftermarket, supplying genuine OEM parts and accessories to body shops, collision centers, and repair facilities across North Carolina, South Carolina, and southern Virginia.

The distributor maintains an inventory valued at more than $10 million, covering 22 vehicle brands from luxury and performance lines to hybrids and commercial models. A network of over 30 dealerships feeds the supply chain, while factory-trained and certified parts personnel provide technical support for identification and sourcing. An in-house delivery fleet offers free next-day service throughout the three-state territory.

Customers range from independent body shops and collision repair centers to mechanical repair facilities and fleet maintenance operations that require original-equipment components for diverse vehicle types. The breadth of brand coverage allows shops to consolidate orders across multiple makes through a single source.

The company positions its one-stop shopping model, rapid delivery, and specialized parts expertise as key differentiators for repair businesses aiming to minimize vehicle downtime.

name: Holsen Solar
old_description: Holsen Solar is a licensed electrical and building contractor serving Eastern ND and Western MN. Solar, EV chargers, permanent lighting, and smart home automation — permitted and warranted.
about:
Holsen Solar was founded in 2018 in Fargo, North Dakota, by Ben Holsen, who drew on a background in entrepreneurship and technology to establish a full-service electrical contracting and solar company. The business remains headquartered in Fargo and operates as a licensed electrical and building contractor serving eastern North Dakota and western Minnesota.

The company designs, permits, installs, and warranties all projects in-house without subcontractors. Its services include rooftop, ground-mount, pole-mount, and tracking solar arrays; Level 2 EV charger installations; permanent architectural LED lighting (Gemstone residential and Haven commercial); battery backup systems using Tesla Powerwall, Franklin WH, and EG4 units; and energy management via Span smart panels and Emporia monitoring. As of the latest figures, the firm has completed over 200 projects and employs a team of 16 licensed electricians and certified installers.

Holsen Solar serves residential homeowners, farmers, small businesses, municipalities, and apartment developers across its service area. Commercial solar work is available statewide in both North Dakota and Minnesota. Recent projects include a 25 kW commercial rooftop system in Fargo, a full-roof commercial array on a metal building in Moorhead, and a complex three-story residential Gemstone lighting installation in Pelican Rapids, Minnesota.

The company emphasizes that the people who sell a system are the same people who install and service it. Its stated differentiators include holding master electrical and contractor licenses in both states, performing all work under its own permits, providing transparent pricing with detailed breakdowns, guaranteeing on-time completion, and offering a comprehensive in-house labor and materials warranty backed by manufacturer warranties. Local knowledge of utilities, cooperatives, inspectors, and weather conditions is cited as a key advantage.

name: Holt Lumber Company LLC
old_description: Holt Lumber Company LLC is a lumber and building materials supplier based in Clarksburg, West Virginia. They provide dimensional lumber, wood products, and building materials to contractors and homeowners in the region.
about:
Holt Lumber Company operates from Clarksburg, West Virginia, as a family-owned business serving the Appalachian region. The company supplies kiln-dried hardwoods and live-edge slabs to woodworkers, contractors, and homeowners across West Virginia, Pennsylvania, Virginia, Tennessee, Kentucky, and Ohio.

The company stocks a range of domestic hardwoods — including black walnut, cedar, white oak, and red oak — and offers custom woodworking, consulting, and delivery services. Its team mills and acclimates lumber on-site, providing dimensional lumber, building materials, and bespoke pieces built from customer-supplied photos or drawings.

Customers include professional woodworkers, residential builders, and DIY enthusiasts. Testimonials reference projects such as a walnut bar top, cedar and walnut lumber packages, and white-oak shelving with red-oak skirt boards, illustrating the mix of retail and custom work.

Holt Lumber emphasizes locally sourced Appalachian hardwoods from West Virginia mills, premium kiln-dried stock with moisture-content guidance, and a relationship-driven approach rooted in family ownership and hands-on expertise.

name: Honest Components, Inc
old_description: We source and supply new, obsolete, and hard-to-find board-level electronic components — all independently tested at ISO/IEC 17025-accredited labs. Every order is certified, compliant, and backed by our 90-day quality guarantee.
about:
Honest Components, Inc. is based in Tampa, Florida, and operates as a woman-owned small business certified by the U.S. Small Business Administration. The company is led by President Jackie Schwab, who brings over 30 years of sales leadership in the electronic components industry. Founded on the principle that honesty and integrity create lasting partnerships, the business focuses on supplying obsolete and hard-to-find board-level electronic components to customers where reliability is essential.

The company maintains a line card of over 50,000 board-level components from manufacturers such as AMD, Intel, and Texas Instruments, covering connectors, capacitors, microcontrollers, and memory chips. Honest Components provides sourcing, procurement, and testing services, leveraging a global network of vetted suppliers. Every order undergoes third-party authentication at independent laboratories accredited to ISO/IEC 17025:2017 and AS6171, including visual inspection, X-ray imaging, decapsulation, solderability, and functional testing. The firm reports more than 200,000 authentic components supplied and over 50 combined years of industry experience among its team.

Honest Components serves aerospace, defense, medical, healthcare, and industrial sectors, supporting OEMs, contract manufacturers, and government contractors. As an ITAR-registered entity and a member of the Government-Industry Data Exchange Program (GIDEP), the company is authorized to manage U.S. defense-related components and actively combats counterfeit parts in the supply chain.

The company differentiates itself by bearing the cost of independent third-party testing on every order, backing shipments with a 90-day form-fit-function guarantee, and maintaining certifications including ISO 9001:2015, AS9120B, and WOSB status. Its mission centers on transparency, risk-based quality processes, and enabling customers to maintain production schedules and extend the life of legacy systems.

name: Honolulu Furniture Company, Custom Furniture Maker Honolulu / Kakaako
old_description: , we specialize in fine custom furniture and cabinetry and also offer heirloom furniture refinishing. Each piece is carefully crafted using quality materials and close attention to detail, creating furniture that is both beautiful and built to last.
about:
Honolulu Furniture Company was founded in 2008 by German furniture maker Thorben Wuttke in Honolulu, Hawaii. Operating from a studio on Cummins Street in the Kakaako district, the company began as a woodworking practice focused on custom-built pieces for local clients.

The shop produces custom furniture, cabinetry, and heirloom refinishing for residential and commercial projects. Each piece is built in-house using wood and finished with a two-part acrylic polyurethane coating for durability. The studio handles projects from concept through fabrication, with a typical turnaround of eight to ten weeks.

The company serves homeowners, architects, interior designers, and businesses across Oahu. Its client base includes both private residences and commercial spaces, with the team collaborating directly with design professionals to realize specific visions.

Wuttke positions the operation as a manufacturer rather than a retailer, emphasizing a tailored approach and craftsmanship intended to last generations. The business was started to provide a direct, local alternative to mass-produced furniture, offering close collaboration and attention to detail on every project.

name: Hoosier Custom Plastics
old_description: Hoosier Custom Plastics LLC Specializes in Tight Tolerance Plastic Insert Molding and Plastic Injection Molding
about:
Hoosier Custom Plastics LLC was founded in 2004 in Ober, Indiana. The company specializes in tight tolerance plastic insert molding and plastic injection molding.

The company provides plastic insert molding, injection molding, over molding, and value-added light assembly including sonic welding, O-ring installation, and box build assembly. It also produces biopolymer moldings for environmentally friendly applications. Hoosier Custom Plastics handles production volumes ranging from a few thousand to several million pieces per year, manufacturing components such as caster wheels, electrical connectors, sealing systems, golf tees, food handling parts, gardening components, automotive transmission and interior parts, and appliance components for washers, dryers, and dishwashers.

The company serves the automotive, aerospace and defense, and electrical industries. Its customer base includes manufacturers of automotive components, aerospace and defense contractors (as indicated by NADCAP accreditation), and producers of electrical and consumer goods.

Hoosier Custom Plastics emphasizes quality and delivery performance with competitive pricing, and its tight tolerance capabilities set it apart for precision molded parts.

With a natural eye for detail and an aptitude for perfection, House of Alpine is founded and lead by Mike Rudd, an Industrial designer turned furniture maker. The company was founded by Mike Rudd, an industrial designer who previously built and expanded a furniture business in Sydney, Australia, before moving to the United States. Rudd serves as lead industrial designer and furniture maker, guiding the company’s creative direction. The business is structured as a small, independently owned operation.

The workshop designs and manufactures custom solid wood furniture, managing the process from hand selection of each lumber piece through artisan craftsmanship to final finishing. The focus is on elegant, sophisticated, and simplistic furnishings intended to last for generations. No facility size or employee count is disclosed, but the company describes itself as a small local provider.

House of Alpine primarily serves residential customers in the Denver area seeking high-quality, affordable custom furniture. The company positions itself as a local source for bespoke pieces, though no specific commercial or industrial clients are named.

Rudd’s background in industrial design and his passion for nature and the outdoors inform the company’s aesthetic, which he describes as honest, passionate, and authentic. The stated goal is to create furniture that endures a lifetime, reflecting the surrounding Rocky Mountain environment.

name: House of Sharp
old_description: At House of Sharp, custom turnkey metal fabrication solutions has never been so accessible. With an in-house graphic designer, artist, CAD designer, mechanical engineer, a team of skilled fabricators, and a fully-outfitted metal shop, we have both the passion and expertise to turn your vision into reality. Whether working with other Kansas businesses or the public, we pride ourselves in offering a premiere customer experience, unbeatable craftsmanship, and products that not only meet, but exceed your wildest expectations.
about:
House of Sharp operates from a 4,000-square-foot facility in Mulvane, Kansas, just outside Wichita. The company was founded in January 2018 by co-owners Ernest Sharp and Rose Hansen, who started with a CNC plasma table built in the basement of a rental house. Sharp, a college student at the time, and Hansen, looking to leave a 9-to-5 job, combined technical fabrication skills with creative design to launch the business.

The shop provides turnkey custom metal fabrication, handling design through production in-house. The team includes a graphic designer, CAD designer, mechanical engineer, and skilled fabricators working with a fully equipped metal shop. Capabilities span CNC plasma cutting, welding, and assembly, producing items such as custom signs, railings, furniture, interior accents, gates, fences, bike racks, awards, and decorative screens. The facility also includes a showroom and retail storefront.

House of Sharp serves both commercial clients and individual customers across Kansas. Projects have ranged from restaurant staircases and fireplace wraps to driveway arches, pet gates, and branded signage for local businesses. The company works directly with architects, contractors, and homeowners, delivering both functional and artistic metalwork.

The founders emphasize a business driven by passion, talent, creativity, and fun, aiming to offer a premiere customer experience and craftsmanship that exceeds expectations. Their differentiator lies in the integration of design, engineering, and fabrication under one roof, allowing them to take projects from concept to finished product without outsourcing.

name: Howard Foods Inc
old_description: Our Sweet Pepper Relish is made with the plumpest, sweetest red bell peppers, while our Hot Pepper relish is made with red bell peppers and green peppers. Or try our Classic Green Tomato Piccalilli with the sweet and savory taste like your great grandmother used to make, made of green tomatoes, red peppers, onions, brown sugar, cider vinegar and a secret blend of spices.​
about:
Howard Foods Inc. operates from Danvers, Massachusetts, where its sales office has been based since 1990. The company traces its origins to the early 1890s when John F. Howard and his wife Margaret began producing relishes in the barn behind their Bradford home, drawing on recipes developed for Howard's Haverhill hotels. The business was formally incorporated after Howard sold it to Arthur D. Dickson in 1924, and a year later merged with the C.E. Chapin Company (founded 1872) to consolidate production in a Haverhill plant. Subsequent owners included ERE Industries, John Labatt Limited, and Campbell Soup Company (Canada) before the current ownership group acquired the brand in 1990.

The firm manufactures a line of shelf-stable condiments that includes Sweet Pepper Relish, Hot Pepper Relish, Green Tomato Piccalilli, Ham Glaze, and Garlic and Onion Seasoning Juices. Production follows the original late-19th-century formulations, which the company says have never been altered. While the historic plant once stood on the river in Haverhill, the current manufacturing location is not disclosed; the Danvers office coordinates sales through New England grocery chains, foodservice distributors, and a direct-to-consumer online store.

Howard Foods serves retail grocery, foodservice, and e-commerce channels primarily in the New England region. Its relishes are marketed to supermarkets, delis, and restaurants that feature them on sandwiches, charcuterie boards, and holiday spreads. The Sweet Pepper Relish is described as the top-selling product in its category nationally, though specific volume figures and customer names are not public.

The brand's differentiation rests on its uninterrupted recipe heritage — the 1900 Grand Prix award in Paris for purity and quality is still cited — and on a positioning that emphasizes natural ingredients, simplicity, and a "homemade" taste maintained across more than 130 years.
